newsitem.title: NIGER: Niger oppositions holds protest march.
newsitem.headline: Niger oppositions holds protest march.

text.p: An estimated 2,000 opposition supporters marched peacefully in Niger's capital on Sunday as part of first anniversary protests against the election of coup maker Ibrahim Bare Mainassara as president, witnesses said.

The eight-party Front for the Restoration and Defence of Democracy (FRDD) staged the protest to mark the anniversary of the supreme court ratifying the result of the election, during which Mainassara scrapped the election commission in mid-poll.
Witnesses reported similar protests outside Niamey, notably in Zinder, stronghold of former civilian president Mahamane Ousmane, whom Mainassara ousted in January 1996. No incidents were reported.
Security forces cracked down on a similar protest on July 8 to mark the first anniversary of the poll. They arrested and then released dozens of opposition militants. They had banned those protests.
Mainassara, then army chief, took power in the arid and impoverished former French colony after a standoff between Mahamane and his prime minister paralysed government for over a year.
